title: GalNX payload section
description: Declarative description of the files a self-contained GalNX NSP must ship on its romfs and copy to the SD card on first run. Validated by src/galnx/payload/plan.py; the romfs layout is planned by build_plan() and written by materialize().

version.description: Payload generation id, written to game_files.txt. Bump it whenever include/exclude change so the engine re-extracts a stale install.

target.description: Absolute SD-card directory the payload is copied to on first launch, e.g. /kirikiri/haruno. Must not be the card root.

startup.description: Absolute SD-card path of the file the engine starts after extraction, inside target (e.g. /kirikiri/haruno/data.xp3).

marker.description: Absolute SD-card path of the marker file the engine writes after a successful extraction, optionally prefixed with sdmc: (e.g. sdmc:/switch/kirikiroid2/.galnx_extracted).

source_dir.description: Read-only game directory scanned for payload files. Relative paths resolve against the manifest directory. Only file names and sizes are read.

ui_dir.description: Engine romfs directory whose files are copied to the romfs root (UI assets, fonts, default cursor).

include.description: Glob patterns selecting payload files, anchored at source_dir. * and ? do not cross directory separators, ** matches zero or more directories. Default: *.xp3, *.cf, plugin/*.tpm.

exclude.description: Glob patterns removed after include is applied. Default: *.sig, **/*.sig (signatures are never copied). Chinese-patched archives are usually excluded with *_chs.xp3.

keymap.description: Optional input keymap generated into the payload root. A string is shorthand for {profile: name}; the profile must be a built-in GalNX input profile and is only used to cross-check coverage, the emitted bindings come from the K2NX defaults.

profile.description: Built-in input profile used for coverage checks (kb_mouse, generic-vn, krkr-ns, ...).

template.description: Alternative XML template path; the template pad set must match the bindings exactly and only value digits are rewritten.

bindings.description: Pad virtual-key code (e.g. 448 for VK_PAD1) to Windows virtual-key code (e.g. 13 for VK_RETURN). Keys may be numbers, VK_PAD names or button names.

file.description: File name the keymap is generated as, in the payload root. Default Kirikiroid2Preference.xml.

payload_dir.description: romfs sub-directory holding payload files. Default game; the engine reads romfs:/<payload_dir>/<file>.

manifest_name.description: File name of the generated extraction manifest in the romfs root. Default game_files.txt.

notes.description: Free-form operator notes, not consumed by the tool.
